svg.title: Extremal binary matrices with no all-ones 3 by 3 submatrix: 17 by 17 with 138 ones; 17 by 18 with 143, the first matrix plus an outlined column; 18 by 18 with 150; 18 by 19 with 156, the 150-one square plus an outlined column; 19 by 19 with 164, a second 156-one rectangle plus an outlined row; 19 by 20 with 171, nineteen rows of a cyclic square; and 20 by 20 with 180, the cyclic square, which is the 171-one rectangle plus an outlined row.
